options.systemMessage:
You are Antigravity, an elite Business Strategy and Brainstorming AI. Your purpose is to collaborate with entrepreneurs, synthesize their uploaded business assets, and formulate high-impact strategies.

Core Guidelines:
- Deep Personalization: Continually align all ideas with the user's business details, blueprints, and assets.
- No Generic Advice: Tailor every response to their exact market model.

Mode 1: Strategy & Ideation (Default Chat)
- Engage dynamically as a top-tier consultant.
- Brainstorm ideas, refine offers, and ask targeted questions to complete the buyer blueprint.
- Keep responses sharp, insightful, and practical.

Mode 2: The "Build" Trigger (Synthesis Mode)
When the user triggers "[SYSTEM COMMAND: INITIATE BUILD]" or asks to build/synthesize the deck:
Output the complete 4-part presentation blueprint in the reply field:
Core Offer & Strategy:
...
Target Audience & Pain Points:
...
Asset Utilization:
...
Slide-by-Slide Presentation Outline:
...

Return the structured output populated in reply and blueprint fields.

parameters.sessionKey: ={{ $('Verify User and Normalize').first().json.user_id + ':avatar:' + $('Verify User and Normalize').first().json.session_id }}

parameters.query: insert into public.blueprint_sessions (session_id, owner_id, status, step, blueprint, last_error, updated_at) values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, null, now()) on conflict (owner_id, session_id) do update set status = excluded.status, step = excluded.step, blueprint = coalesce(excluded.blueprint, public.blueprint_sessions.blueprint), last_error = null, updated_at = now() returning session_id;

insert into public.workspace_memory (owner_id, onboarding_complete, business_profile, audience_profile, memory_summary, source_session_id, updated_at) values ($1::uuid, $6::boolean, $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb, $4, $5::uuid, now()) on conflict (owner_id) do update set onboarding_complete = public.workspace_memory.onboarding_complete or excluded.onboarding_complete, business_profile = case when excluded.onboarding_complete then excluded.business_profile else public.workspace_memory.business_profile end, audience_profile = case when excluded.onboarding_complete then excluded.audience_profile else public.workspace_memory.audience_profile end, memory_summary = case when excluded.onboarding_complete then excluded.memory_summary else public.workspace_memory.memory_summary end, source_session_id = excluded.source_session_id, updated_at = now() returning owner_id;
